chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The criterion for rajm is that four witnesses testify that they saw him entering and withdrawing.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةٌ: four persons, the required number of witnesses here
key_terms.حَدُّ: the legally prescribed limit or fixed punishment
key_terms.رَأَوْهُ: they saw him directly with their own eyes
key_terms.وَيُخْرِجُ: and withdraws, completing the explicit legal description
key_terms.يَشْهَدَ: to testify formally as legal witnesses
key_terms.يُدْخِلُ: he inserts, describing the act explicitly
key_terms.ٱلرَّجْمِ: stoning as a hadd punishment in the specified legal context

ai.seo_question: What is the required testimony to establish the hadd of rajm for zina in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the evidentiary requirement for establishing the hadd of rajm in a zina case. It emphasizes that the punishment is not applied unless four witnesses testify to having directly observed the act in explicit detail.
